model.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL SFT 4B
model.description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL SFT: the quality-focused CFG variant of the XL 4B DiT (acestep-v15-xl-sft). Runs true classifier-free guidance with Adaptive Projected Guidance at a free step count (30 by default) instead of the Turbo distilled 8-step schedule. Highest audio quality in the ACE-Step family; several times slower than Turbo.
